Subsection 1: VPD across OzFlux
- Driver importance using random forest

Compare the importance of Temp, VPD, precipitation, cwd 7 day, LAI, and shortwave radiation 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)

standardise <- function(train, test, vars_to_scale) {
  # Fit scaling on train only, apply to both - avoids data leakage
  scale_params <- lapply(vars_to_scale, function(v) {
    list(mean = mean(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
         sd   = sd(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  names(scale_params) <- vars_to_scale
  
  for (v in vars_to_scale) {
    train[[v]] <- (train[[v]] - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
    test[[v]]  <- (test[[v]]  - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
  }
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

run_rf_for_site <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  df <- df %>% drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data:", nrow(df), "rows"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Add lagged variables and rolling CWD
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
                                      align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      Tair_lag1 = lag(Tair, 1),
      Tair_lag2 = lag(Tair, 2),
      Tair_lag3 = lag(Tair, 3),
      VPD_lag1  = lag(VPD, 1),
      VPD_lag2  = lag(VPD, 2),
      VPD_lag3  = lag(VPD, 3)
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Train/test split
  set.seed(123)
  idx        <- createDataPartition(df$GPP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- df[idx, ]
  test_data  <- df[-idx, ]
  
  predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", "cumulative_cwd_7day"
                )
  
  # Scale train, apply same params to test
  scaled     <- standardise(train_data, test_data, predictors)
  train_data <- scaled$train
  test_data  <- scaled$test
  
  # Fit RF
  model <- randomForest(
    GPP ~ Tair + SW_rad + VPD + Precip + cumulative_cwd_7day,
    data  = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry  = 3,
    importance = TRUE  # needed for permutation importance
  )
  
  # Predict and metrics
  predictions    <- predict(model, test_data)
  results        <- data.frame(Observed = test_data$GPP, Predicted = predictions)
  rmse           <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
  rsq            <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
  mean_observed  <- mean(results$Observed)
  nse            <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                        sum((results$Observed - mean_observed)^2)
  
  # Variable importance - use %IncMSE (permutation based, more reliable than IncNodePurity)
  imp <- importance(model, type = 1)  # type=1 is %IncMSE
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    variable   = rownames(imp),
    importance = imp[, 1],
    site       = site_name
  )
  
  return(list(
    site        = site_name,
    model       = model,
    metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
    importance  = importance_df,
    predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name)
  ))
}

# Apply to all sites
rf_results <- map2(sites_daily, names(sites_daily), run_rf_for_site)

# Remove NULLs from sites with insufficient data
rf_results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rf_results)
cat("Sites successfully fitted:", length(rf_results), "\n")

# Extract metrics and importance
all_metrics    <- map_df(rf_results, ~.x$metrics)
all_importance <- map_df(rf_results, ~.x$importance)

print(all_metrics)

# Plot importance in groups of 6 sites
site_names <- unique(all_importance$site)
n_groups   <- ceiling(length(site_names) / 6)

for (i in 1:n_groups) {
  start_idx    <- (i - 1) * 6 + 1
  end_idx      <- min(i * 6, length(site_names))
  sites_subset <- site_names[start_idx:end_idx]
  
  p <- ggplot(all_importance %>% filter(site %in% sites_subset),
              aes(x = reorder(variable, importance), y = importance)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    facet_wrap(~site, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 8)) +
    labs(title = paste("Variable Importance - Group", i),
         x = "Variable", y = "%IncMSE")
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(paste0("importance_group_", i, ".png"), width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)

standardise <- function(train, test, vars_to_scale) {
  # Fit scaling on train only, apply to both - avoids data leakage
  scale_params <- lapply(vars_to_scale, function(v) {
    list(mean = mean(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
         sd   = sd(train[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  names(scale_params) <- vars_to_scale
  
  for (v in vars_to_scale) {
    train[[v]] <- (train[[v]] - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
    test[[v]]  <- (test[[v]]  - scale_params[[v]]$mean) / scale_params[[v]]$sd
  }
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

run_rf_for_site <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  required_vars <- c("GPP", "Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", 
                    "cwd", "date")
  
  df <- df %>% drop_na(all_of(required_vars))  # only drop NAs in relevant columns
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data:", nrow(df), "rows"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # rest of function unchanged...
  
  # Add lagged variables and rolling CWD
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
                                      align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      Tair_lag1 = lag(Tair, 1),
      Tair_lag2 = lag(Tair, 2),
      Tair_lag3 = lag(Tair, 3),
      VPD_lag1  = lag(VPD, 1),
      VPD_lag2  = lag(VPD, 2),
      VPD_lag3  = lag(VPD, 3)
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Train/test split
  set.seed(123)
  idx        <- createDataPartition(df$GPP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- df[idx, ]
  test_data  <- df[-idx, ]
  
  predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "Precip", "cumulative_cwd_7day")
  
  # Scale train, apply same params to test
  scaled     <- standardise(train_data, test_data, predictors)
  train_data <- scaled$train
  test_data  <- scaled$test
  
  # Fit RF
  model <- randomForest(
    GPP ~ Tair + SW_rad + VPD + Precip + cumulative_cwd_7day,
    data  = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry  = 3,
    importance = TRUE  # needed for permutation importance
  )
  
  # Predict and metrics
  predictions    <- predict(model, test_data)
  results        <- data.frame(Observed = test_data$GPP, Predicted = predictions)
  rmse           <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
  rsq            <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
  mean_observed  <- mean(results$Observed)
  nse            <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                        sum((results$Observed - mean_observed)^2)
  
  # Variable importance - use %IncMSE (permutation based, more reliable than IncNodePurity)
  imp <- importance(model, type = 1)  # type=1 is %IncMSE
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    variable   = rownames(imp),
    importance = imp[, 1],
    site       = site_name
  )
  
  return(list(
    site        = site_name,
    model       = model,
    metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
    importance  = importance_df,
    predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name)
  ))
}

# Apply to all sites
rf_results <- map2(sites_daily, names(sites_daily), run_rf_for_site)

# Remove NULLs from sites with insufficient data
rf_results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rf_results)
cat("Sites successfully fitted:", length(rf_results), "\n")

# Extract metrics and importance

all_importance <- map_df(rf_results, ~.x$importance)

print(all_metrics)

# Plot importance in groups of 6 sites

for (i in 1:n_groups) {
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Normalise importance within each site (0-1) so sites are comparable
all_importance_norm <- all_importance %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(importance_norm = (importance - min(importance)) / 
                           (max(importance) - min(importance))) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(all_importance_norm, aes(x = variable, y = site, fill = importance_norm)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1,
                       name = "Relative\nImportance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)) +
  labs(x = "Predictor", y = "Site", 
       title = "RF Predictor Importance Across Australian Flux Sites")
```

Compare model without VPD and model with VPD

```{r}
standardise <- function(df, vars_to_scale) {
  df_scaled <- df
  df_scaled[vars_to_scale] <- scale(df[vars_to_scale])
  return(df_scaled)
}
```


```{r}
run_rf_with_without_vpd <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  # Only drop NAs in columns we always need
  df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, Tair, SW_rad, VPD, cwd, date)
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
                                      align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Predictors with and without VPD
  predictors_with    <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "cumulative_cwd_7day")
  predictors_without <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "cumulative_cwd_7day")
  
  fit_rf <- function(predictors, label) {
    
    # Drop NAs only in columns this model actually uses
    model_df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, all_of(predictors))
    
    if (nrow(model_df) < 100) {
      message("  Skipping ", label, " at ", site_name, ": insufficient data after NA drop")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Standardise
    model_df <- standardise(model_df, predictors)
    
    # Train/test split
    set.seed(123)
    idx        <- createDataPartition(model_df$GPP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
    train_data <- model_df[idx, ]
    test_data  <- model_df[-idx, ]
    
    formula <- as.formula(paste("GPP ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
    
    model <- randomForest(formula, data = train_data,
                          ntree = 500, mtry = 3, importance = TRUE)
    
    preds         <- predict(model, test_data)
    results       <- data.frame(Observed = test_data$GPP, Predicted = preds)
    rmse          <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
    rsq           <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
    mean_observed <- mean(results$Observed)
    nse           <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                         sum((results$Observed - mean_observed)^2)
    
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      variable   = rownames(importance(model)),
      importance = importance(model, type = 1)[, 1],
      model      = label,
      site       = site_name
    )
    
    list(
      metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, model = label,
                               RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
      importance  = importance_df,
      predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name, model = label)
    )
  }
  
  with_vpd    <- fit_rf(predictors_with,    "with_VPD")
  without_vpd <- fit_rf(predictors_without, "without_VPD")
  
  if (is.null(with_vpd) || is.null(without_vpd)) return(NULL)
  
  list(
    site        = site_name,
    metrics     = bind_rows(with_vpd$metrics,     without_vpd$metrics),
    importance  = bind_rows(with_vpd$importance,  without_vpd$importance),
    predictions = bind_rows(with_vpd$predictions, without_vpd$predictions)
  )
}

# Run across all sites
rf_results_vpd <- map2(sites_daily, names(sites_daily), run_rf_with_without_vpd)
rf_results_vpd <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rf_results_vpd)

# Extract
all_metrics_vpd    <- map_df(rf_results_vpd, ~.x$metrics)
all_importance_vpd <- map_df(rf_results_vpd, ~.x$importance)

print(all_metrics_vpd)

```

```{r}

# ---- Plot 1: R² with vs without VPD per site ----
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(site, R2), y = R2, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("with_VPD" = "#2E86AB", "without_VPD" = "#A23B72")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Model R²: with vs without VPD",
       x = "Site", y = "R²", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# ---- Plot 2: R² difference (gain from adding VPD) ----
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  select(site, model, R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = R2) %>%
  mutate(R2_gain = with_VPD - without_VPD) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(site, R2_gain), y = R2_gain, fill = R2_gain > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2E86AB", "FALSE" = "#A23B72"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "VPD improves R²", "FALSE" = "VPD reduces R²")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "R² gain from adding VPD",
       x = "Site", y = "ΔR² (with - without VPD)", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
library(lubridate)

convert_to_annual <- function(df_daily) {
  df_daily <- df_daily %>%
    mutate(year = year(date))
  
  df_annual <- df_daily %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      GPP    = sum(GPP,    na.rm = TRUE),
      ET     = sum(ET,     na.rm = TRUE),
      Precip = sum(Precip, na.rm = TRUE),   # mean annual precip → sum daily → already correct
      Qle    = mean(Qle,   na.rm = TRUE),
      Tair   = mean(Tair,  na.rm = TRUE),   # ✅ mean annual temperature
      SW_rad = mean(SW_rad, na.rm = TRUE),
      Rn     = mean(Rn,    na.rm = TRUE),
      Pa     = mean(Pa,    na.rm = TRUE),
      VPD    = mean(VPD,   na.rm = TRUE),
      LAI    = max(LAI_4day,    na.rm = TRUE),   # ✅ maximum annual LAI — added this
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  return(df_annual)
}

# Apply to all sites
sites_annual <- map(sites_daily, convert_to_annual)
```

```{r}
sites_annual_combined <- bind_rows(sites_annual, .id = "site")

# Summarise across years per site
sites_summary <- sites_annual_combined %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_precip = mean(Precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tair   = mean(Tair,   na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lai     = max(LAI,     na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Pivot to long for faceting
sites_summary_long <- sites_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -site, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
    mean_precip = "Mean Annual Precip (mm)",
    mean_tair   = "Mean Annual Temp (°C)",
    max_lai     = "Max Annual LAI"
  ))

ggplot(sites_summary_long, aes(x = reorder(site, value), y = value, fill = site)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Site Comparison") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
sites_summary %>%

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)", title = "Sites by Precipitation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# ── Plot 1: R² with vs without VPD — LAI order ───────────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = LAI_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("with_VPD" = "#4682B4", "without_VPD" = "#F28C28")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "R² with vs without VPD — LAI order", x = NULL, y = "R²", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# ── Plot 1: R² with vs without VPD — wet to dry order ────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("with_VPD" = "#4682B4", "without_VPD" = "#F28C28")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "R² with vs without VPD — Dry to Wet", x = NULL, y = "R²", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# ── Plot 2: ΔR² gain — LAI order ─────────────────────────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  select(site, model, R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = R2) %>%
  mutate(site    = factor(site, levels = LAI_order),
         R2_gain = with_VPD - without_VPD) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2_gain, fill = R2_gain > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4682B4", "FALSE" = "#F28C28"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "VPD improves R²", "FALSE" = "VPD reduces R²")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "ΔR² from adding VPD — LAI order", x = NULL, y = "ΔR² (with − without)", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# ── Plot 2: ΔR² gain — wet to dry order ──────────────────────────────────────
```

```{r}
r2_per_site <- all_metrics_vpd %>%

  select(site, R2) %>%

n_years <- sites_annual_combined %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year))

sites_summary <- sites_summary %>%
  left_join(n_years, by = "site")

r2_per_site <- all_metrics_vpd %>%
  filter(model == "with_VPD") %>%
  select(site, R2)

plot_data <- sites_summary %>%
  left_join(r2_per_site, by = "site")

# ── Max LAI vs R² ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#4682B4") +
  geom_text(aes(label = site), vjust = -0.8, size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +

  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#4682B4") +
  geom_text(aes(label = site), vjust = -0.8, size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  labs(x = "Mean Annual Precip (mm)", y = "R2") +
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

# ── Plot 1: R² (with_VPD only) — wet to dry order ────────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  filter(model == "with_VPD") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%

  labs(
    title = "Model R² (with VPD) — Wet to Dry",

# ── Plot 2: R² vs climate/LAI — three panels ─────────────────────────────────

# Join R² (with_VPD) onto site summary metrics
r2_vpd <- all_metrics_vpd %>%
  filter(model == "with_VPD") %>%
  select(site, R2)

plot_data <- sites_summary %>%
  left_join(r2_vpd, by = "site") %>%
  rename(
    MAP = mean_precip,
    MAT = mean_tair,
    MAL = max_lai
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(MAP, MAT, MAL),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
    MAP = "Mean Annual Precip (mm)",
    MAT = "Mean Annual Temp (°C)",
    MAL = "Max Annual LAI"
  ))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = value, y = R2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#4682B4") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = site), size = 2.8, colour = "grey30",
                  max.overlaps = 15) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(y = "R² (RF with VPD)", x = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black")
  )

```
